Name: System Monitor Pro
Description: See your PC's CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network on the keys: a number, a bar and a two-minute graph for each. Windows only. Not affiliated with Ulanzi.

Actions.Name: CPU usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much of the processor is in use, in percent.

Actions.Name: CPU temperature
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the processor temperature. Needs LibreHardwareMonitor.

Actions.Name: GPU usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much of the graphics card is in use, in percent. NVIDIA only.

Actions.Name: GPU temperature
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the graphics card temperature. NVIDIA only.

Actions.Name: Video memory usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much video memory is in use, in percent. NVIDIA only.

Actions.Name: Memory usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much memory is in use, in percent.

Actions.Name: Ping
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the round trip to a server.

Actions.Name: Packet loss
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the share of pings that got no answer.

Actions.Name: Disk usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how busy the disks are, in percent.

Actions.Name: Disk temperature
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the hottest disk. Needs LibreHardwareMonitor.

Localization.lhm.offline: LibreHardwareMonitor does not answer. This reading needs it, and it is optional: it loads a driver that some game anti-cheats block, so close it before such a game. To use it, open it and turn on Options > Remote Web Server > Run.
Localization.lhm.unconfigured: The LibreHardwareMonitor address is turned off in the plugin's environment variables.
Localization.nvidia.missing: nvidia-smi was not found. It ships with the NVIDIA driver, and these readings only work with an NVIDIA card.
Localization.nvidia.offline: nvidia-smi stopped answering. It is started again shortly.
Localization.windows.offline: The disk counters could not be read.
Localization.os.offline: The processor and memory could not be read.
Localization.unsupported: This reading only exists on Windows.
